fusions.name: Bar-Bender's Wrench
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. You wrench at it for 9 damage and leave it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Arms
fusions.desc: Sweeps both arms inward, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bars Slammed Down
fusions.desc: Drives a line of bars 5 tiles long into the ground for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Penned Quarry
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
